title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI hooks and metrics integration for regression gating
author: Maya Singh
release_notes: Add per-prompt CI hooks and integrate eval metrics into main CI to detect prompt-level regressions early. No user-facing breaking changes.
description: Motivation: We have seen regressions slip through when changes affect narrow prompt-sets. This PR adds per-prompt CI hooks and a lightweight eval-metrics integration to the main CI so regressions are detected and surfaced as CI failures. Summary: 1) Introduce per_prompt_ci hook runner that loads a configurable set of prompt-sets and runs the eval harness on changed models and changed prompt-sets. 2) Add a metrics collector that publishes per-prompt pass/fail and delta metrics to CI annotations and our internal metrics endpoint. 3) Wire the new checks into GitHub Actions workflows with explicit ignore lists and rerun-once behavior to reduce flakiness. Checklist: - [x] Implement per_prompt_ci runner and config loading - [x] Add CI workflow step and annotations - [x] Publish metrics to metrics-api (dev/staging only by default) - [x] Add documentation and example prompt-set config - [x] Add unit and integration tests - [x] Run full eval-harness job on sample repo. Commits summary: - Add per_prompt_ci runner and CLI entrypoint - Add CI workflow changes and GH annotations - Metrics collector service and local mock - Tests for per_prompt runner and CI integration - Docs: how to add prompt-sets and expected failure modes Changed areas/files (high-level): - eval-harness/runner/per_prompt_ci.py: new runner with config schema and retry logic - eval-harness/ci/per-prompt-workflow.yml: new GH actions workflow step integrated into existing pipeline - eval-harness/metrics/collector.py: collects per-prompt metrics, publishes to CI annotations - eval-harness/tests/test_per_prompt.py: unit + integration tests - docs/eval-harness/per-prompt-ci.md: docs and example config - .github/workflows/eval-harness.yml: add conditional hook step - examples/prompt-sets/README.md: example prompt-set and expectations Review conversation: "Rafael Ortiz: Can you clarify how prompt-sets are discovered? Reply: The runner loads prompt-sets from a configurable directory and will only run the ones that intersect with the PR diff or explicit CI config. Rafael Ortiz: What about flakiness? Reply: We add a retry-once policy and record seed/instance metadata in annotations to help debugging. Lena Hoffman: Are we publishing any sensitive data to metrics-api? Reply: No; metrics are aggregate counts and hashes of prompt identifiers only. Samir Patel: Suggest adding a flag to skip slow model tests in quick CI. Reply: Added --fast flag and CI matrix coverage. Rafael Ortiz: Approving after CI fixes. Lena Hoffman: Approved. Samir Patel: Approved with comments resolved."
